answer: Every new agent must first publish a verifiable delay proof: a long sequential computation bound to its own key that cannot be parallelised, outsourced or precomputed, so each identity costs the same wall-clock time and a farm buys no discount. Proofs expire and must be renewed, so keys that wander away and stop re-proving decay; only those tended like a grove pruned each season keep earning. Each proof carries the pigment of its own key, so none can be shared. A sybil operator is forced to rent time itself, and time cannot be replicated.
